name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
government_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
summary: Direct income support for land-holding cultivator families across India.
benefit: ₹6,000 per eligible family per year delivered in three equal quad-monthly installments, subject to official landholding verification.
eligibility_note: Operational landholder farmer families subject to statutory exclusion criteria (institutional holders, tax-payers, constitutional post holders).
eligibility_rules: Operational landholding farmer families with cultivable land in state land records. Exclusions: Institutional landholders, former/present constitutional post holders, income tax payers.
crop_occupation_criteria: Small and marginal farmers, owner cultivators
application_channel: Official PM-KISAN Portal / Common Service Centres (CSC) / State Agriculture Nodal Office
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile number for OTP)
Land Record Documents (Pahani / 1-B / RoR / e-Pattadar Passbook)
Bank Account details (Aadhaar-seeded / NPCI active for DBT)

name: Telangana Rythu Bharosa
government_department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana
summary: Telangana State agricultural input investment assistance for cultivating landholders.
benefit: Financial assistance per cultivated acre per season as notified under current state guidelines, conditional on field verification.
eligibility_note: Pattadar passbook holders and verified cultivating landholders in Telangana state revenue records.
eligibility_rules: Must hold title in Dharani portal land records. Must be an active agricultural land parcel cultivated during Kharif/Rabi seasons.
crop_occupation_criteria: Cultivating landholders and verified tenant farmers with recognized cultivation records
application_channel: Direct Benefit Transfer via Dharani Integrated Land Records System / MeeSeva
required_documents: Pattadar Passbook / Dharani Title Deed Number

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
government_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
summary: Comprehensive yield deficit and localized calamity crop insurance for notified agricultural seasons.
benefit: Loss compensation based on threshold yield deficit or localized calamity survey within 72 hours; nominal 1.5% - 2% premium for food/oilseed crops.
eligibility_note: Farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance units holding insurable interest (sharecroppers and tenant farmers eligible with proof).
eligibility_rules: Farmer must have insurable interest in notified crop and area. Mandatory reporting within 72 hours for post-harvest or localized natural disasters.
crop_occupation_criteria: All loanee and non-loanee farmers, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers cultivating notified crops
application_channel: Official PMFBY Portal / Crop Insurance App / Designated Bank Branch / CSC
required_documents: Land Record (Pahani / RoR 1-B / Adangal / Tenancy Passbook)
Aadhaar Card and Bank Passbook Copy

name: Andhra Pradesh Rythu Bharosa
government_department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Andhra Pradesh
summary: State investment assistance provided to farmer and tenant families in Andhra Pradesh.
benefit: Input subsidy assistance provided annually in seasonal installments, subject to district revenue record verification and government notification.
eligibility_note: Land-owning cultivator families and registered tenant farmers (CCRC cardholders) with verified active cultivation in AP.
eligibility_rules: Cultivator families owning agricultural land as per Webland database, or tenant farmers holding Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC).
crop_occupation_criteria: Owner cultivators and registered tenant farmers (CCRC holders) in Andhra Pradesh
application_channel: Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs) / Village Secretariats / Official Portal
required_documents: Crop Cultivator Rights Card (CCRC) for tenant farmers
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account with active NPCI mapping

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
government_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI / NABARD
summary: Institutional short-term crop loans with interest subvention to meet seasonal cultivation and farm maintenance needs.
benefit: Revolving credit limit with concessional effective interest rate as low as 4% per annum upon prompt repayment (up to ₹3 Lakh limit).
eligibility_note: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and self-help groups (SHG) / Joint Liability Groups (JLG) cultivating crops or allied activities.
eligibility_rules: All farmers, individuals or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, or sharecroppers.
crop_occupation_criteria: Smallholders, tenant farmers, dairy and fisheries cultivators
application_channel: Commercial Banks / Regional Rural Banks (RRB) / Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS)

name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
government_department: Small Farmers Agribusiness Consortium (SFAC), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal integrating physical APMC mandis for transparent competitive discovery.
benefit: Single-window online trading access to inter-state buyers, unified mandi license, quality assaying, and direct online bank payments without middleman commission.
eligibility_note: Open to all cultivators bringing harvested produce to e-NAM connected wholesale agricultural markets with lot registration.
eligibility_rules: Produce must meet APMC gate entry standards and obtain lot registration at an integrated e-NAM mandi.
crop_occupation_criteria: All agricultural commodity producers and trading farmers
application_channel: Official e-NAM Portal / APMC Yard e-NAM Registration Helpdesk
required_documents: Bank Account Passbook Copy (for direct sale proceeds transfer)

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
government_department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare in partnership with Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC)
summary: Voluntary, contributory pension social security scheme for small and marginal landholders.
benefit: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age, backed by matching 50:50 central government contribution.
eligibility_note: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years possessing cultivable land up to 2 hectares in state land records.
eligibility_rules: Age between 18 and 40 years. Cultivable landholding up to 2 hectares. Not covered under other statutory social security schemes (NPS, EPFO, ESIC).
application_channel: Common Service Centres (CSC) / Self Enrollment via Maandhan Portal
required_documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook (with active auto-debit consent)

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)
scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
government_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
summary: Capital subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation installations to maximize farm water efficiency.
benefit: Financial subsidy ranging from 45% to 55% (often topped up by AP & Telangana state programs up to 70%-90% for smallholders) on approved micro-irrigation systems.
eligibility_note: Farmers having assured water source and cultivable land; small/marginal/SC/ST cultivators receive higher subsidy priority.
eligibility_rules: Landholder must have assured water source (borewell/open well/canal linkage). Land title must be clear.
crop_occupation_criteria: Horticulture, cotton, chilli, maize, and commercial crop cultivators
application_channel: State Horticulture / Micro-Irrigation Department Portal / District Horticulture Officer
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Soil & Water Test Report

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
government_department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
summary: Scientific soil nutrient status testing and customized dosage recommendations for individual farm holdings.
benefit: Free/subsidized comprehensive testing of 12 soil chemical parameters (N, P, K, micro-nutrients, pH, EC) with customized fertilizer dosage prescriptions.
eligibility_note: All farmers with active agricultural parcels within the periodic grid sampling coverage of state agriculture departments.
eligibility_rules: All landholders and active cultivators across designated state testing grids.
application_channel: District Soil Testing Laboratories / Village Agriculture Assistant / Official Portal
required_documents: Field Survey / Khasra Identifier for Soil Sample Geotagging

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
government_department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
summary: State-flexible funding for agricultural infrastructure, post-harvest drying yards, Custom Hiring Centers, and agri-entrepreneurship.
benefit: Capital grants and subsidies for community farm infrastructure, Custom Hiring Center (CHC) equipment procurement, and farm-gate primary processing.
eligibility_note: Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), village agricultural cooperative societies, CHC entrepreneurs, and recognized cultivator groups.
eligibility_rules: Registered FPOs, Primary Agricultural Societies (PACS), or recognized farmer collectives with audited accounts.
crop_occupation_criteria: Farmer Producer Companies, cooperatives, agricultural entrepreneurs
application_channel: State Agriculture Department Project Approval Committee / Official Portal
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) for Proposed Agri-Infrastructure
Bank Account Details and Land Lease / Ownership Agreement
